task: Reference-informed prairie willow and cottonwood finish

speciesIdentification.smallerLeftMiddle: Populus deltoides, previously generic oak studio model

references.observations: Narrow lanceolate leaves, irregular spreading crown, thick furrowed bark. Actual bark, leaf and form photos interpreted from page screenshot.
references.rights: Virginia Tech photographs copyright; viewed as references only, not used in game textures.

references.observations: Actual cottonwood bark image inspected: gray-brown ridged plates and branched fissures; broad vase-shaped irregular crown described.
references.rights: University photographs copyright; reference inspection only.

references.observations: Regional identity, triangular leaves, massive deeply furrowed gray bark.

implementation: Prairie-only finish retains seeds, dimensions, placement and centerline branching; thinner secondary wood and species-informed existing leaf sprays.
Recovered continuous path/tangent frames from inherited segment chains; matched radii remove visible joint wedges.
Generated irregular bark albedo, 1024-square WebP, 468948 bytes, shared map/bump texture with metric branch-aligned UVs.
UVs and material hook guarded to ECO389 prairie preview; canonical shared tree assets are not mutated.

assetProvenance.method: Built-in image_gen, generated for this project, not a downloaded reference photo
assetProvenance.seamlessStatus: Requested tileable; no formal edge equality guarantee or production approval claimed.

review.decision: Retain improved bark, joint continuity and finer foliage for human review
review.rejected: Analytic stripe bump treatment and first rigid leaf-spray arrangement. Actual failure images/source preserved in rejected-striped-finish.
review.visibleImprovement: Close-up no longer has bright gaps around each curved branch section; smooth brown tubes replaced by uneven gray-brown bark. Secondary limbs are less oversized.
remaining: Retained oak-derived centerline hierarchy remains a species approximation.
Willow sprays can still read as flat fans at close range; no claim of photorealistic or final botanical approval.
Prairie ground and shrub representation remain unfinished outside this tree pass.

pugetRegression.scope: Shared renderer before/after; approved Puget encounter camera, seed 29, wind off.

validation.otherProtectedBiomes: Not broadly recaptured; no source recipe edits and only prairie-scoped renderer hooks.
